audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a gentle, upbeat electronic piano melody accompanied by a soft, rhythmic synth beat. A male voice speaks in a friendly, lighthearted tone, followed by the muffled sound of bedsheets rustling. A ding SFX marks a transition as the atmosphere shifts slightly to an indoor room. (2) A female voice enters, speaking with a playful, somewhat whiny but cheerful inflection. The BGM remains consistent, maintaining a moderate tempo of around 125 BPM. Short, sharp pop and click SFX are interspersed as objects are moved. The vocal intensity is moderate, typical of a casual conversation. (3) A distinct whoosh SFX leads into a phase with audible road hum and car engine noise. The female voice becomes more focused and narrative. The BGM ducks slightly to prioritize the speech. A camera shutter SFX is heard as the acoustic environment transitions to an open street space. (4) The soundscape becomes dense with crowd chatter and a faint reverb typical of a large hall. The BGM swells, adding energetic drum patterns and synthesizer layers. A microphone's slight feedback and amplified vocal quality suggest a public address. Frequent impact and sparkle SFX highlight various visual tech interactions. (5) In the final phase, the crowd noise fades, replaced by a quieter outdoor ambient floor with distant city sounds and wind. The female voice returns to a calm, professional yet friendly narrative tone. The BGM slows down, ending with a final soft chord and a ding SFX.
